GOTCHU_STORES.DESCRIPTION: Tell Gotchu which store each inbox belongs to. A Messenger page or a website widget usually belongs to one shop. A mailbox that several shops forward into belongs to none: leave it shared and list each shop's address below.
GOTCHU_STORES.NO_STORES: No Shopify store is connected to this account yet. Connect a store first, then map its inboxes here.
GOTCHU_STORES.UNCONFIGURED: Gotchu is not configured on this Chatwoot. An operator needs to set GOTCHU_GATEWAY_URL, a gateway secret for this account, and GOTCHU_GESTURE_SECRET.

LOAD_FAILED.TITLE: Could not load your stores
LOAD_FAILED.UNAVAILABLE: Gotchu did not answer. Reload the page to try again.
LOAD_FAILED.UNCONFIGURED: Gotchu is not configured on this Chatwoot.

GOTCHU_STORES.SAVED: Mapping saved. New conversations are routed with it from now on.

INBOXES.TITLE: Inboxes
INBOXES.EMPTY: This account has no inboxes yet.

SHOP_EMAILS.TITLE: Shop addresses
SHOP_EMAILS.DESCRIPTION: Addresses that forward into a shared mailbox. Gotchu reads the forwarding address on a conversation's first message and files it under that shop.

SHARED_WARNING.TITLE: Is this mailbox shared?
SHARED_WARNING.DESCRIPTION: Several of your shops forward into this mailbox? Leave it shared and list the shop addresses instead.
SHARED_WARNING.CONFIRM: It belongs to this shop only

UNLISTED.TITLE: Inboxes no longer visible to Gotchu
UNLISTED.DESCRIPTION: These inboxes are still mapped, but Chatwoot no longer lists them for Gotchu -- deleted, or not visible to Gotchu's Chatwoot user. Saving keeps each one mapped to its current store unless you remove it below.
UNLISTED.PENDING_REMOVAL: Will be removed from {store} when you save

ERRORS.UNCONFIGURED: Gotchu is not configured on this Chatwoot.
ERRORS.UNAVAILABLE: Gotchu did not confirm the change. Reload to see what was saved.
ERRORS.INVALID: One or more inboxes or addresses cannot be used. Check the addresses and try again.
ERRORS.DUPLICATE: An inbox or an address is assigned to more than one store.
ERRORS.ONE_PER_CHANNEL: A store can hold one inbox per channel. Leave the other one shared.
ERRORS.STORES_CHANGED: Your stores changed since this page was opened. Reload and try again.
ERRORS.UNCONFIRMED: Could not confirm the save. Reload the page to see whether it landed.
ERRORS.UNLISTED_INBOX_DROPPED: Inbox {ids} is no longer visible and was not acknowledged for removal. Reload the page and decide again.
